_comment: How much power each KIND of skill reasonably needs.
This is the yardstick for the question 'did this skill need that much access?'
A skill declares which category it belongs to, and this file says what a skill
of that kind should reasonably be able to do.
Note this is a completely different question from 'did the skill tell the
truth?'. A skill can be perfectly honest about wanting sweeping access and
still be over-powered for its job. That is why the two checks read different
inputs and can never collapse into one another.
'allowed'   - the capabilities a skill of this kind may reasonably ask for.
'max_scope' - how wide those capabilities may reasonably reach. A capability
not listed here may reach anywhere.
